_about: Card e9d95660 (marveen decision B, 10022702): the fix-round hand-over cases BOTH verdict readers must agree on. Read by scripts/__tests__/verdict-parse.test.py and src/__tests__/kanban-verdict-fix-round-shared.test.ts. created_at = position in the list. "open" = the authors whose last verdict is still open, sorted. Only plain column-0 "VERDIKT:" lines with "|" separators: the two readers tokenise other shapes differently (bold, "." separator, "(severity)") and that is outside this rule.
